== Official composed source and chronology ==
Documented image layouts follow supported source order. Repository timestamps identify preserved full-face copies; archive capture and printed edition identify partial occurrences. Unknown first publication days are not assigned.
* '''Original full face''' ([[Yoxgit (V)]]): preserved in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 the first Holotable repository import, 8 July 2018]. The card may predate that import.
* '''Earlier full-face correction''' ([[Yoxgit (V) (Errata)]]): the preserved September 2019 full face changes Maz’s Palace to Maz’s Castle and prints unnumbered E. This earlier published state is retained.
* '''Errata 2, earlier partial''' ([[Yoxgit (V) (Errata 2)]]): present in the complete official PDF archived at 2021-10-05T19:33:58Z; prints unnumbered E.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-9-archive-2021-10-05-pages-1-3-5-extract.pdf|Official Set 9 PDF archived 5 October 2021]], original page 5 (lossless extract page 3).</ref>
* '''Errata 3, current full face''' ([[Yoxgit (V) (Errata 3)]]): the [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/hires/yoxgit.png source PNG] was authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z. The later [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 GIF copy] was committed 19:39:59Z that UTC day; their complete RGB pixels and dimensions are identical. Prints E1. This state retains the supported <code>209_14</code> mapping.
* '''Errata 4, later partial''' ([[Yoxgit (V) (Errata 4)]]): October 2023 sheet edition; prints E1. Title/badge typography differs from the earlier partial; Yoxgit additionally changes its frame and E mark to E1. The two sheet occurrences are distinct published layouts, not merely different encodings.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-9-October-2023.pdf|Official Set 9 sheet, October 2023 edition]], page 5.</ref>
The actual printed marks are recorded separately from image-version ordinals in [[Players Committee transcription errors]]. [[File:V9-L-yoxgit-Set9-2021-2023-partial-comparison.png|thumb|center|300px|Earlier and later published partial layouts.]]

No new executable ID is created for a partial. The existing supported ID stays on the moved full-face article. The complete official source region is retained; embedded-background-only extraction would omit vector text/icons on original page 3. Original page 5 is raster. Upper fields and rule-derived values are explicitly distinguished from printed partial fields. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
